excerpt.en: Our deep-cover operatives have stepped-up their surveillance on potential targets.

scope.zh: 间谍行动“招募线人”的阶段事件、结局以及相关通知。
scope.en: The espionage operation Acquire Asset: stage events, finale and related notices.

texts.zh: 我们暗中潜伏的特工已经加强了对于潜在目标的监控。
texts.en: Our deep-cover operatives have stepped-up their surveillance on potential targets.

texts.zh: 我们的“观察员”正开始和那些被我们标记为有潜在用处的目标套近乎。
texts.en: Our 'spotters' have begun ingratiating themselves with targets we've marked as potentially useful.

label.zh: 该阶段检定成功后，下一阶段开始
label.en: When this stage succeeds, the next stage begins

texts.zh: 一份目标的候选名单已经拟定。那些不再承担监视任务的特工将为其他人提供掩护。
texts.en: A shortlist of targets has been drawn up. Those operatives who are no longer tasked with surveillance will provide cover for the others.

label.zh: 该阶段检定成功后，下一阶段开始
label.en: When this stage succeeds, the next stage begins

texts.zh: 随着行动接近尾声，间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经转而保护我们在[target.GetName]内的新线人。其余特工随时准备着为[spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]提供任何可能需要的掩护措施。
texts.en: As the operation nears its conclusion, Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has moved to secure our new Asset within the [target.GetName]. Our remaining operatives are poised to facilitate any cover [spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] may need.

note.zh: 游戏会按这位人物的性别选用代词。
note.en: The game picks the pronoun that fits this character.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位人物的名字。
note.en: In the game, the character's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现目标帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the target empire appears here.

texts.zh: 间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]从[from.target.GetName]发回报告：到目前为止此项计划进展顺利。我们已经确保了同一位[from.target.GetAdj]政府高层官员联络的通路。这位线人已经被保护起来，同时蓄势待发，做好了在未来行动中协助我们的准备，尤其是当我们遇到外交或是政府层面的问题时。
texts.en: Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports from the [from.target.GetName]: a successful execution so far. We have secured access to an official within the [from.target.GetAdj] civic hierarchy. This Asset will be kept secure but poised, ready to assist us with future operations - particularly when we might brush up against diplomatic or governmental issues.

summary.text:
# 招募线人 / Acquire Asset

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/nemesis_operations_events_1.txt, common/espionage_operation_types/operations.txt · DLC：Nemesis · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

玩家对一个国家发起间谍行动“招募线人”（common/espionage_operation_types/operations.txt:280-337）：3个阶段（需要灭绝/新霸权DLC，对象为普通国家），花费 45 影响力和 6 能量/月，一次只能进行一个行动；每个阶段完成时触发对应阶段事件。
The operation Acquire Asset has three stages (45 influence, 6 energy upkeep, one operation at a time); each completed stage fires its event.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. operation.1000 “动员特工”：特工加紧监视潜在目标。 Operatives step up surveillance.
2. operation.1001 “收缩势力范围”：拟定候选名单。 A shortlist is drawn up.
3. operation.1002 “建立线人联系”：选项“开始行动！”→ operation.1006 “线人已获取”：在目标国官僚体系中获得一名线人，供以后的行动使用（排在最后）。 Launch -> 1006 Asset Acquired.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 阶段依次发生；失败的检定可能引出“行动失手”随机事件（见各失手故事）。 Stages in order; failed rolls may trigger the mishap events.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 需要新霸权（Nemesis）DLC。 Needs Nemesis.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：行动类型定义与 operation.1000-1006。 Checked the operation type and 1000-1006.
